title: AsyncAPI v1.1.0 - Topic Item
description: Describes the operations available on a single topic

$ref.description: Allows for an external definition of this topic item. The referenced structure MUST be in the format of a Topic Item Object

parameters.description: A list of the parameters included in the topic name. The list MUST NOT include duplicated parameters

publish.description: Describes a publish or a subscribe operation. It can be a single message or a list of alternative messages

subscribe.description: Describes a publish or a subscribe operation. It can be a single message or a list of alternative messages

deprecated.description: Declares this topic to be deprecated. Usage of the declared topic SHOULD be refrained
